nodes.label: Space Survival 3D production rules (Blender to Unity)
nodes.rationale: Single reference for any session that models, animates or integrates a model; rules valid only for this project (Unity 6000.4 Built-in RP, Standard shader; Blender 5.3 French UI via MCP).

nodes.label: §0 Working with the user
nodes.rationale: Answer in French, ask before modeling with concrete choices, send renders after each model, export directly to Unity, be honest about what was not verified in Unity, never redraw a validated model.

nodes.label: §1.1 General spirit (Subnautica-inspired clean industrial)
nodes.rationale: Modular bases inspired by Subnautica but with an own DA, never copying assets; clean high-tech readable industrial, simple silhouettes, detail concentrated on bands, joints and panels.

nodes.label: §1.2 Flat material palette M_<Model>_<Suffix>
nodes.rationale: Suffix (_White, _Dark, _Metal, _Neon, _Orange, _Glow, _Plate, _Hazard, _Status, _Glass, _Cell, _Fire, _Hologram, _Laser) drives automatic Unity .mat creation. White dominates 60-70%, graphite 20-30%, thin blue neon 1-2 bands, orange rare (1-4 lights), _Fire only behind a window, hazard only on thresholds/handles. Find Principled node by type because the UI is French.

nodes.label: §1.3 Forms (no 90 degree edges, facets)
nodes.rationale: Every edge gets a large 45 degree chamfer or a 6 mm edge break (EB=0.006); octagonal cylinders, geodesic domes, prof6 hexagonal section for habitable modules; detail by small add-ons 1-6 mm above surface; graphite bases sunk below z=0; shade_smooth + sharp from 35 degrees.

nodes.label: §1.4 Reference dimensions
nodes.rationale: Player about 1.80 m; interior walking floor 0.215 m; solid walls max 1.20 m with glazing above.

nodes.label: Standard flange (PASS / SHELL prof6 profiles, Socket empties)
nodes.rationale: Same flange for dome connector, airlock and all tunnels so any new network module chains through Socket empties (exit axis -Y Blender).

nodes.label: Walkable passage clearance (player collider)
nodes.rationale: Player collider about 0.85 m diameter x 1.70 m (CapsuleCollider scaled 0.85 in Player.prefab); standalone module doors at least 1.1 m x 1.9 m.

nodes.label: §1.4 bis Autonomous habitable models (capsule)
nodes.rationale: Hollow faceted shell, door facet in 4 pieces; flush door folding into a ramp with hinge 4.5 cm outside the sill and computed open_angle(); stop the leaf under the lintel since the top rises passing vertical; empty interior when the user furnishes it in Unity; temporary _InteriorLight for renders.

nodes.label: §1.4 ter Storage and stackable objects
nodes.rationale: Lid covers the whole top (cut lids showed slits); StackPoint empty for stacking, loaded crate cannot open; hinge axis 2 cm outside lid edge (HINGE_OFF) with L brackets so the lid does not float; doors offset 6 mm.

nodes.label: §1.4 quater Wall objects (inside domes)
nodes.rationale: Dome inner wall is a smooth cylinder of radius R_OUT-0.25 (3.75/5.75/7.75 m); origin at wall contact, front -Y; curved objects tighter than the smallest dome on a 2.5 cm graphite plate, checked with wall_clearance(); smooth sweep() when asked; one-piece facade avoids corner seams; temporary _Wall for renders.

nodes.label: §1.5 Glass (thin closed prisms)
nodes.rationale: Simple planes gave inconsistent normals and missing glass; _Glass is Blended with backface culling off in Blender and Standard Transparent in Unity.

nodes.label: §1.6 Textures (paused)
nodes.rationale: Everything is flat materials; ModelImportSetup already handles <Model>_BaseColor/_Normal/_MetallicSmoothness/_Occlusion/_Emission if re-enabled; do not produce without request.

nodes.label: §1.7 Éléments naturels (roches, gisements, items de ressource)
nodes.rationale: Natural elements keep the same visual family as manufactured objects (facets, flat materials, readability) but with their own rules; no added detail, reading by silhouette and 3 material tones; root empty + single static Body child, convex MeshCollider, 50-600 triangles.

nodes.label: No wild flora decision
nodes.rationale: The planet is arid (orange Mars-like ground); the only plants will be terrestrial crops grown inside domes (food, wood: F53); no alien plants for now.

nodes.label: Low-poly faceted rock generation (convex hull + break planes)
nodes.rationale: Convex hull of 12-30 points on a noisy ellipsoid, random break planes (bisect_plane + fill), dissolve_limit 4 degrees, tri_ngons; large blocks are clusters of 2-3 interpenetrating hulls; sharp from 20 degrees. The §1.3 chamfer/edge-break rule does not apply since rocks have fracture edges.

nodes.label: Natural element ground anchoring (base sunk 8-15%)
nodes.rationale: Origin at ground contact center, flat-cut base sunk 8-15% of height so it never floats on terrain slopes.

nodes.label: Fixed seed per model (random.Random(name))
nodes.rationale: Re-running the script reproduces exactly the same shapes, so validated variants are never altered; only the reported point is fixed.

nodes.label: Natural palette (M_<Kit>_<Suffix>)
nodes.rationale: Suffixes _Basalt, _BasaltShade, _Rust, _RustShade, _Dust, _Iron, _Copper, _Titanium, _Coal, _Ice, _Diamond, _Quartz, _Amethyst, all added to FlatPalette with Unity metal/gloss values.

nodes.label: Rock tone distribution by face normal
nodes.rationale: _Dust if n.z > 0.93, _...Shade if n.z < -0.15, main tone otherwise; automatic per face.

nodes.label: Opaque crystals (no _Glass)
nodes.rationale: Standard shader transparency sorts overlapping crystal clusters badly; rely on high gloss and the diamond's small emission instead.

nodes.label: Rock kit (Rocks/, 18 Rock_<Type>_<Size>_<1..3>)
nodes.rationale: Types Basalt and Rust; sizes S 0.35-0.55 m (pebble, step-over), M 0.9-1.4 m (low obstacle), L 2.4-3.4 m (block, cluster of 2-3 hulls, non-convex collider).

nodes.label: Hand-harvestable deposits kit (Deposits/, 24 Deposit_<Resource>_<1..3>)
nodes.rationale: One size 0.7-1.0 m, three models per resource, host rock always basalt; drill-mounted large outcrops will be a separate later kit.

nodes.label: Inlaid ore veins (Iron, Copper, Titanium)
nodes.rationale: Face bands cut between two slightly converging bisect planes, extruded 8 mm along normals to avoid z-fighting; 2-4 thin local veins 4-8 cm wide starting from one top area and crossing; never wrapping around the rock (tied-parcel look).

nodes.label: Coal strata
nodes.rationale: 2 near-horizontal strata 3.5-6 cm, staggered, partially wrapping; more or thicker strata make the rock entirely black.

nodes.label: Protruding crystals (Quartz, Amethyst, Diamond, Ice)
nodes.rationale: Planted 3 cm below the surface and tilted around the surface normal: quartz hex prisms in bunches of 3-7, amethyst short stubby clustered prisms, diamond half-embedded octahedra 4-8 per deposit, ice irregular convex blocks.

nodes.label: Picked-up resource items kit (ResourceItems/, 9 Item_*)
nodes.rationale: Model used at drop/pickup (ItemData.Model), 10-18 cm, origin at bottom center; ore chunks mostly in the ore colour since veins would not read at that size; diamond, quartz and amethyst exist only as models, not yet items.

nodes.label: §2 Procedural modeling method (bmesh scripts)
nodes.rationale: Everything generated by Python bmesh, never by hand; one xx_build.py per model; one .blend per model or kit in ArtPipeline/Blends, never under Assets; objects prefixed _ are neither deleted nor exported; budget up to ~20k triangles per module.

nodes.label: Axis convention (-Y Blender = +Z Unity, z=0 ground)
Model hierarchy (root empty, PascalCase children, pivot origins)
§3 Export (Blender to Unity)
nodes.rationale: One folder per model (or kit) under Assets/Resources/Models containing only the fbx and generated .mat/.controller; FBX name = root empty = folder name, used as key in ModelImportSetup; root reset to identity before export; temporary renaming of Socket/Body duplicates; re-import check after export.

nodes.label: Mandatory FBX export settings
nodes.rationale: FBX_SCALE_UNITS, bake_space_transform False, axis_forward -Z, axis_up Y, mesh_smooth_type FACE, no leaf bones; bake_anim only for animated models.

nodes.label: §4 Unity import: ModelImportSetup.cs
nodes.rationale: bakeAxisConversion=false and preserveHierarchy=true for all models, otherwise models tip 90 degrees when a clip plays; children keep Blender local axes; materials created in the same folder only; controller created only if missing; Dome_* readable for runtime wall cutting; always check Editor.log for error CS.

nodes.label: §5 Animations (Blender)
nodes.rationale: Single 24 fps timeline per model, clips separated by 10-18 empty frames, forward/back pairs ending on stable poses, LINEAR *_Loop/*_Spin 0 to 360; one moving part = one object = one animated property; mandatory BVH collision, z-fight and key-pose render checks before export.

nodes.label: Current clip tables (ModelClips)
nodes.rationale: CraftStation, Airlock, RelayAntenna, SolarPanel, WindTurbine, CoalGenerator, LandingCapsule, Drill, Crate_Small, Crate_Large, Cabinet, ControlPanel.

nodes.label: §6 Unity Animator (generated controllers)
nodes.rationale: Controller generated by CreateController; simple models use DefaultState and AutoTransitions; independent movements use ModelLayers, one layer per group, curves of other layers stripped in OnPostprocessAnimation, Write Defaults off, Idle state when no default clip, <Layer>Speed float per looping clip.

nodes.label: ModelLayers (one Animator layer per independent group)
§7 Runtime C# animation scripts (<Model>Animator.cs)
nodes.rationale: One component per model on the instance root (shared script only if logic is identical, detecting clips in the controller); controller assigned by hand; clear verb-based public API; CrossFadeInFixedTime / Play in Awake / coroutines; French comments; store translation target at clip start; symmetric clips resume with 1 - normalizedTime.

nodes.label: Animator overwrite pitfall (script-owned angle in LateUpdate)
nodes.rationale: The Animator rewrites every animated transform each frame; script-driven transforms keep their own angle field and impose it absolutely in LateUpdate, never incremental Rotate; measure angle when switching from a loop clip, Play with Mathf.Repeat(angle/360) to go back.

nodes.label: Variable length parts and orientable chimney collar
nodes.rationale: Chimney_Shaft stretched in localScale.z, Chimney_Head child of root (not shaft) to avoid inheriting scale, Chimney_Collar solid graphite disc stretched into an ellipse via SetCollarRotation; none animated by clips.

nodes.label: Holographic screen recipe (Hologram, Hologram_Screen)
nodes.rationale: Preferred to a _Glow screen for a futuristic look; Hologram_Screen quad with UV 0..1 for a future UI; hidden when unpowered or scale animated 0.001 to 1 from the lens.

nodes.label: Hydraulic cylinders (open tube + sliding rod)
nodes.rationale: Rod never touches the tube, keeping the BVH test clean.

nodes.label: §8 Mistakes already made (do not repeat)
nodes.rationale: 24 lessons: inverted normals, plane glass, coplanar z-fighting, materials.clear() resetting indices, 90 degree tipping, CS0136 compile error, stale FBX meta (keep GUID), materials at Models root, script rotating animated transforms, controller generated before layers, folding collisions, Socket.001, manual pose ignored at render, concave n-gons discarded by Unity (tri_ngons), quaternion camera, etc.

nodes.label: Concave n-gon triangulation (tri_ngons)
nodes.rationale: Unity discards self-intersecting polygons, leaving holes; triangulate faces with more than 4 sides (BEAUTY) after finish2 and search 'self-intersecting' in Editor.log.

nodes.label: BVH collision test over clip frames
nodes.rationale: BVHTree.overlap sampled at least every 2 frames, including optional/repositionable parts in their worst position.

nodes.label: §9 Reference scripts (ArtPipeline/Blender/)
nodes.rationale: Run in Blender via MCP with SP pointing to the folder; new model recipe: xx_build.py exec al_build, make_mats, setup/animate, checks, export, update ModelImportSetup, write Animator, update this doc.

nodes.label: nt_build.py (natural elements kit builder)
nodes.rationale: setup(Rocks/Deposits/ResourceItems), export(kit), rock_hull, ground_rock, tone, veins, crystals, hex_crystal, octahedron, surface_points, zcheck.

nodes.label: ModelImportSetup.FlatPalette
nodes.rationale: Unity equivalent of the Blender palette; any new suffix must be added here or Unity creates no material.

nodes.label: AirlockAnimator
nodes.rationale: Enforces never both doors open and pressure requirement per door.

nodes.label: SolarPanelAnimator
nodes.rationale: Tracks -sun.transform.forward only once deployed.
